title: Palafin 200/197 Illustration Rare Obsidian Flames Pokemon Akira Komayama 2023
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
Palafin – Pokemon Obsidian Flames – 200/197 – ILLUSTRATION RARE
You will receive the exact card pictured. These are photos of the actual card, not stock images. Front, back, and close-ups of all four corners are shown.
Card details
Name: Palafin (Stage 1, Water) – evolves from Finizen
150 HP
Set: Obsidian Flames (OBF), 2023
Card number: 200/197
Rarity: Illustration Rare
Illustrator: Akira Komayama
Copyright: © 2023 Pokemon / Nintendo / Creatures / GAME FREAK
Language: English
Attacks
Jet Punch (Water) – 30 damage. This attack also does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokemon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokemon.)
Justice Kick (Water, Water) – 210 damage. If this Pokemon didn't move from the Bench to the Active Spot this turn, this attack does nothing.
Weakness: Lightning ×2. Resistance: none. Retreat cost: 2.
Flavor text: This Pokemon's ancient genes have awakened. It is now so extraordinarily strong that it can easily lift a cruise ship with one fin.
Note for collectors: this is an Illustration Rare. Obsidian Flames has 197 cards in the main set, so numbers above 197 are the special-rarity pulls that come only from the tail end of the set. Illustration Rares use full-frame alternate artwork that extends across the whole card rather than sitting in a window, and they are pulled far less often than the standard set cards.
Condition: Ungraded, in the condition shown. Please review all photos closely and judge for yourself – the images are of the actual card and are the most accurate description of its condition. Corner close-ups are included so you can assess edge and corner wear directly.
